Can the Government clarify the Biomedical review and approval process, including required documentation, anticipated review criteria, and timing of approval? A75. Before purchasing radiology equipment, VANTHCS Biomedical approval is required to ensure compatibility, safety, and security within the VA network. Key steps in the process are as follows: 1. Enterprise Risk Assessment (ERA) Clearance (Prerequisite): • All equipment proposed for purchase must have completed and been granted ERA clearance—a mandatory cybersecurity and risk assessment approval for connecting medical devices to the VA network. • ERA clearance ensures the equipment meets VA’s technical and security standards for integration. 2. Pre-Purchase Verification: • Vendors must verify if a specific equipment make/model has ERA clearance before purchase. • To request verification, vendors should contact the Biomedical Engineering team at ntxbiomedicalengineers@va.gov. The team will confirm ERA status and provide official guidance. 3. Consequences of Non-Approved Purchases: • Should equipment without ERA clearance be purchased and delivered, it cannot be connected or deplo

ess ERA approval or are likely to be approved, to avoid delays in deployment. For verification of ERA approval status or additional guidance, please contact ntxbiomedicalengineers@va.gov. Q77. Please provide annual laboratory volumes and phlebotomy encounters for the previous fiscal year. A77. The VA does not track laboratory volumes and phlebotomy encounters at the contact CBOCs. Q78. Please identify any laboratory testing expected to be performed onsite versus tests referred to the VA Core Laboratory. A78. Section 5.4, Ancillary Support Services, page 36, under Ancillary Point of Care, and Waived Testing Services states mandated POC testing includes dipstick urine analysis, rapid strep, blood glucose (glucometer tested fingerstick), rapid influenza A and B, and rapid COVID 19. Point-of-care qualitative urine pregnancy testing is also required. Q79. Please confirm whether additional same-day courier runs are required for STAT or urgent testing beyond the required daily courier pickup. A79. If urgent or stat lab work is ordered while the Veteran is at the clinic, it is the contractor’s responsibility to have a mechanism in place to ensure the results are available in the time frame needed for the provider to urgently make care decisions for the Veteran.

Der Märkische Kreis ist ein seit 1975 bestehender Kreis in Nordrhein- Westfalen. Er liegt im Nordwesten des Sauerlands und gehört zum Regierungsbezirk Arnsberg und zur Region Südwestfalen. Der Märkische Kreis setzt sich aus fünfzehn Gemeinden zusammen. Es wird eine leistungsfähige, sichere und wirtschaftliche Mobilfunklösung gefordert, die Sprach- und Daten- Kommunikation umfasst. Als Voraussetzung für die Angebotsabgabe gilt, dass der Bieter Netzbetreiber ist und in Deutschland über ein oder mehrere eigene Mobilfunkn etze verfügt und diese selbst betreibt. Ein Mobilfunk-Kartenmanagement von Seiten des Bieters ist gefordert. Der Märkische Kreis setzt ein elektronisches Ticketsystem ein. Das Online Portal und das Kartenmanage- ment sind an dieses Ticketsystem über entsprechende Schnittstellen anzubinden. Die Kompatibilität und An- bindung an das Ticketsystem „Matrix 42“ sind im Angebot zu bestätigen. Für die Benutzung des Portals ist vom Auftragnehmer für den Benutzerkreis eine Schulung (1 Tag) anzubieten. Der Bieter hat die wesentlichen Funktionen und den Leistungsumfang des angebotenen Online- Portals im Angebot nachvollziehbar darzustellen. Der Nachweis kann beispielsweise durch Produktunterlagen, aussage- kräftige Screenshots, Bedienungsdokumentationen oder – sofern verfügbar – einen Demo-Zugang erfolgen. Die Wahl der Nachweisform obliegt dem Bieter. Weiterhin ist nachvollziehbar darzustellen, dass sämtliche im Leistungsverzeichnis geforderten Verwaltungs - und Nutzungsfunktionen über das angebotene Online-Portal unterstützt werden. The Postbox is an online submission facility which allows buyers to receive responses from suppliers electronically in a secure environment. Responses are submitted through the portal and held in the secure Postbox until the deadline for responses has expired. Nominated members of the buyer organisation then unlock the Postbox to access the submissions. The Postbox can be used for the receipt of PQQs, tender responses, Quick Quote submissions and all supporting documents. A full audit trail is kept of all access to the Postbox and a complete record of all supplier submissions is stored. The goal is to obtain (quantitative) information about patients’ health status at the point of need and in a CLIA-waived environment without going through traditional central laboratory testing, which requires laboratory skills, long turn-around times, and can lead to delays in receiving care. Bijvoorbeeld: FLU20D037 – Kwalificatie ‘Indienstellingen Gas’ Pagina 6/14 Indien er een overeenkomst afgesloten wordt voor ‘Eerste ID gas van de lage druk meters’ (zie hoofdstuk 3 – Overeenkomst binnen de kwalificatie ‘Indienststellingen Gas’), dient de opdrachtnemer alle aanvragen die hij ontvangt van klanten uit de regio(s) waarvoor hij zich heeft gekwalificeerd, ook binnen de daartoe vastgestelde termijnen uit te voeren. De kandidaat geeft zijn keuze met betrekking tot de gewenste regio(’s) aan in het daartoe bestemde document (bijlage 7 – Invulblad regio’s). Doorheen de looptijd van de kwalificatie is het mogelijk regio’s toe te voegen of te verminderen, dit steeds in samenspraak met de contactpersoon van de aanbesteder van dit dossier, vermeld in hoofdstuk 4 – Specifieke dossiergegevens. De vraag om regio’s toe te voegen of te verminderen dient per mail aan de contactpersoon van de aanbesteder te worden gesteld en is definitief na bevestiging van de aanbesteder. INDIENEN KWALIFICATIEDOSSIER Verloop van de procedure Dit is een open procedure, kandidaten kunnen op elk ogenblik vragen om gekwalificeerd te worden. Daartoe dienen zij een aanvraag in volgens de regels bepaald in dit document. De aanbestede

gekwalificeerd na een positieve beoordeling van de beschreven selectiecriteria en wanneer hij voldoet aan de wettelijke criteria. Dit is een open procedure, kandidaten kunnen ten allen tijde hun aanvraag tot kwalificatie indienen. De aanbesteder kan ook ten allen tijde bijkomende opdrachten toevoegen aan deze kwalificatie. MEDEDELEN BESLISSING De aanbesteder neemt binnen een termijn van zes maanden een beslissing over de kwalificatie van de kandidaten. Indien deze beslissing meer dan vier maanden vergt vanaf het neerleggen van de aanvraag, licht zij de kandidaat binnen de twee maanden na het neerleggen in over de redenen van verlenging van de termijn en over de datum waarop zijn verzoek aanvaard dan wel zal worden afgewezen. Voldoet een kandidaat aan de vooropgestelde selectie- en wettelijke criteria, dan zal deze worden op genomen in de ’lijst van gekwalificeerden’. Indien er gedurende de looptijd van de kwalificatie wijzigingen optreden waardoor aan bepaalde vooropgestelde criteria niet langer voldaan kan worden, dient het gekwalificeerde keuringsorganisme de aanbesteder hiervan op de hoogte te stellen. Aucune mise à disposition de personnel du CC-IN2P3 ne sera faite pour le déchargement Il est à noter que :  Les véhicules de transport (porteurs ou articulés), peuvent stationner et décharger leurs colis sur le parking privé jouxtant le CC-IN2P3 ;  L’accès livraison aux bâtiments du CC-IN2P3, est donné au quai de déchargement du bâtiment VIL2 ;  Tout dommage occasionné aux fournitures avant leur mise en place définitive sur l’emplacement

Servizio di “Consegna, installazione, configurazione, formazione ed avvio operativo dell’apparecchiatura” fornit a, da erogarsi in conformità alle modalità indicate dal presente Capitolato e dall’Elaborato tecnico; 2. Servizio di “Gestione in garanzia delle apparecchiature”, da erogarsi in conformità alle modalità indicate dal presente Capitolato e dall’Elaborato tecnico. La fornitura dovrà essere installata a regola d’arte e secondo le prescrizioni del presente Capitolato e dall’Elaborato tecnico, eventualment

Statement of Objective/Description of Technical Area(s): The scope of the ARA is to develop technologies with commercial and defense industrial base partners to construct prototype systems that demonstrate microelectronics capabilities yielding technical offset for Department of Defense (DoD) applications. These capabilities also provide protections to ensure military unique chips are protected from malicious exploit (loss of DoD Intellectual Property (IP)) and from malicious tampering during design, manufacturing, and supply chain lifecycle by addressing the entire microelectronics ecosystem. In addressing the assurance of the microelectronics ecosystem, MINSAV facilitates rapid modernization of existing military systems with the microelectronic components required to maintain the technical overmatch for warfighting systems. MINSAV will acquire the design and fabrication of commercial and Government developed sensor (signal) generation and processing microelectronics technologies that enhance national defense capabilities in Position Navigation and Timing (PNT), Autonomy, Communications, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning (AI/ML), Data Processing and Spatial / Spectral Agility (SSA). ip_data_security.text: /RYD) is announcing its intent to solicit proposals under this “ARA with Calls”. Solicitations for white papers/proposals will be accomplished via calls. The calls will encompass the following effort: 1. Statement of Objective/Description of Technical Area(s): The scope of the ARA is to develop technologies with commercial and defense industrial base partners to construct prototype systems that demonstrate microelectronics capabilities yielding technical offset for Department of Defense (DoD) applications. These capabilities also provide protections to ensure military unique chips are protected from malicious exploit (loss of DoD Intellectual Property (IP)) and from malicious tampering during design, manufacturing, and supply chain lifecycle by addressing the entire microelectronics ecosystem. In addressing the assurance of the microelectronics ecosystem, MINSAV facilitates rapid modernization of existing military systems with the microelectronic components required to maintain the technical overmatch for warfighting systems. MINSAV will acquire the design and fabrication of commercial and Government developed sensor (signal) generation and processing microelectronics technologies that enhance national defense capabilities in Position Navigation and Timing (PNT), Autonomy, Commu

efense capabilities in Position Navigation and Timing (PNT), Autonomy, Communications, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning (AI/ML), Data Processing and Spatial / Spectral Agility (SSA). Demonstrations of these technologies and evaluation of the differentiating capability obtained through use of assured, advanced microelectronics are key to achieving the program objectives. Calls to be issued against the MINSAV ARA must a) fall under at least one of the Technical Areas detailed in paragraph I.1.a. below and 2) involve at least one of the types of tasks detailed in paragraph I.1.b. below. a. Sensors Areas of Interest 1) Intellectual Property Acquisition, Development, Manufacturing, and Distribution to Defense Industrial Base (DIB) partners and system developers; 2) Demonstrator Construction and Assessment of differentiating capabilities achievable through implementation of advanced microelectronics; 3) Research and Development (R&D) of processing architectures; 4) Enhancing Availability of Critical and Common IP, Manufacturing, and Assurance Tools to facilitate best supply adoption by DoD research, development, and acquisition programs; Page 5 of 24 5) Acquiring Access to IP sources, Design Capabilities, Manufacturing, and Verification and Validation Services

Data Rights desired by the contractor should be included with proposal submission as part of Section K (Reps and Certs). See attached model contract. The Air Force Research Laboratory is engaged in the discovery, development, and integration of warfighting technologies for our air, space, and cyberspace forces. As such, rights in technical data and NCS developed or delivered under this contract are of significant concern to the Government. The Government will therefore carefully consider any restrictions on the use of technical data, NCS, and NCS documentation which could result in transition difficulty or less- than full and open competition for subsequent development of this technology. In exchange for paying for development of the data, the Government expects technical data, NCS, and NCS documentation developed entirely at Government expense to be delivered with Unlimited Rights.
